sn45.18:1.2: This pair feature up until [sn45.20](). | With the rise of Pāṭaliputta, the “Chicken Monastery” (_kukkuṭārāma_) became an important center after the Buddha’s passing. Malalasekera (*Dictionary of Pali Proper Names*) suggests it was the same monastery later renowned as Aśokārāma. It seems that all the discourses set here are after the Parinibbana.
sn45.18:2.1: Notice that they refer to each other as “reverend”, in apparent violation of one of the Buddha’s final instructions ([dn16:6.2.1]()).
